title: .config/ianf-coupled-tags.toml, version 1
description: A repository's settings for its COUPLED tags, for coupled-tags-lint, which reads the copy on disk in the directory it scans. See coupled-tags-lint's README.

version.description: The version of this file's format.

exclude.description: Path prefixes, from the repository's root, whose tags aren't checked, such as examples and test fixtures.

lock-file.description: The lock file's path from the repository's root, with no `.` or `..` part, so it's inside the repository.
